raw.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT e.metric_path, e.value_num FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric e ON e.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND e.run_id = 'eda:a_quality' AND e.metric_path = 'median_context_vs_images_slope_tokens_per_image'), encoder AS (SELECT image_px, patches, post_merge_tokens FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = true AND image_px = 448 AND n_images = 1 AND post_merge_tokens = 196 GROUP BY image_px, patches, post_merge_tokens) SELECT encoder.image_px, encoder.patches, encoder.post_merge_tokens, current_eda.value_num AS traced_tokens_per_image FROM encoder CROSS JOIN current_eda; SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE raw::text LIKE '%4096%') AS rows_mentioning_4096 FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = true AND image_px = 448 AND post_merge_tokens IS NOT NULL;
